title: Reimport retains obsolete questions while replacing gold
brief_fix: Define merge/replace import semantics; reconcile questions and annotations atomically within the chosen scope.

title: Manual-entry export cannot be idempotently reimported into its history
brief_fix: Reconcile matching manual session IDs without unconditional conflicting INSERT; preserve provenance and reject conflicting content explicitly.

title: Ingestion accepts missing turn IDs and invalid references
brief_fix: Validate schema, unique turn/session IDs and question-history references before publishing an import; allow intentional partial imports only explicitly.

title: Failed question ingestion leaves writes that a later operation commits
brief_fix: Use an explicit import transaction/staging boundary with rollback on every parse/validation failure; publish gold consistently.

title: Unknown speaker labels silently become prior-speaker text
brief_fix: Specify transcript grammar and preview parsed speaker attribution; reject or warn about ambiguous unsupported speaker labels without rejecting ordinary colon-bearing prose.

title: Invalid Config values can violate chunk caps or crash indexing
brief_fix: Validate positive batch/budget values and target/maximum/overlap invariants at configuration construction.

title: Concurrent atomic_json writers share one temporary filename
brief_fix: Use unique same-directory temporary files and atomic replacement; separately lock read-modify-write state that needs serialization.

title: Concurrent index builders race on the indexed readiness marker
brief_fix: Serialize or transactionally claim content/scheme indexing work and make readiness publication idempotent.

title: Live lock-file changes mislabel an existing Models snapshot
brief_fix: Bind model/cache/config provenance to one immutable loaded revision snapshot; reject or explicitly reload after lock changes.

title: MPS recovery covers forward execution but not model allocation
brief_fix: Extend tested recoverable-device handling to model load/allocation with clear cleanup and uncertain resource-state handling; validate on real hardware before reliability claims.

title: Memory.records exposes mutable cached objects
brief_fix: Return immutable records or defensive copies if callers may mutate them; current production callers do not demonstrate this corruption.

title: Unknown requested index histories silently produce zero work
brief_fix: Report missing requested history IDs and require explicit allow-missing behavior for a deliberate empty selection.

title: Lexical retrieval fetches unused embedding BLOBs
brief_fix: Use a lexical SQL projection without vector join/BLOB materialization; benchmark memory and latency before claiming gains.

title: Index boundary trusts vector integrity
brief_fix: Consider dimensions/finite validation when loading untrusted or migrated vectors; production Models.embed already rejects nonfinite outputs.

title: Lexical cue labels do not resolve negation or fact identity
brief_fix: Keep cues as retrieval hints; assess downstream gating against labeled negation/entity/state examples, consolidated under RET-09.

title: Sentence boundaries after spaces do not match real tokenizer offsets
brief_fix: Map punctuation/newline boundaries to valid token ends without consuming following spaces; version memory schema and verify spans.

title: Archive basename/manifest ambiguity permits silent overwrite or empty success
brief_fix: Validate declared archive members and duplicate basenames; expose an explicit partial-import mode rather than accepting ambiguous manifests.

title: Repeated uncached texts in one batch are embedded repeatedly
brief_fix: Deduplicate fresh texts within each model batch and scatter vectors back to chunk IDs; measure work and runtime separately.

title: Old source/index/cache objects have no explicit retention lifecycle
brief_fix: Define audit-snapshot/cache retention and reference-aware cleanup; do not delete immutable sources still referenced by reports.

title: Import discards authoritative public customer/call/product metadata
brief_fix: Preserve validated public session metadata and stable customer/product identity in storage and snapshot provenance; keep evaluation-only outcome labels out of retrieval.

title: Previous-turn context can clip the selected tail assertion at the default cap
brief_fix: Build context as disjoint bounded spans around the selected unit; preserve the target before truncating context.

title: Lexical top-two unit selection drops relevant paraphrases
brief_fix: Generate a broader bounded unit pool and compare relevance/facet selection at a fixed evidence budget; protect answer-bearing units.

title: Text-only deduplication removes distinct later events and dates
brief_fix: Include event/source/time identity in redundancy decisions for temporal questions; retain chronology or merge provenance explicitly.

title: Overlap deduplication drops a short chunk containing novel tail evidence
brief_fix: Deduplicate only when unique non-overlapping evidence is preserved; merge spans or retain the novel tail under the budget.

title: Six excerpts cannot cover arbitrarily many required source sessions
brief_fix: Route exhaustive counts through verified population/explicit-total logic and retain uncertainty when coverage is unknown.

title: Textual role labels can forge a user confirmation inside assistant content
brief_fix: Validate quotes against structured original user-turn spans/IDs instead of reparsing role labels from free text.

title: English confirmation whitelist rejects supported Polish and present-tense acceptance
brief_fix: Test language-aware assertion forms and provenance-linked confirmation, including Polish and present-tense acceptance; do not infer confirmation from keywords alone.

title: A matching quote is not proof of negation scope or same-fact resolution
brief_fix: Add auxiliary entailment/state review using full source context and entity/fact links; preserve the existing semantic-verification disclaimer.

title: Update expansion gate lacks verified fact links and state completeness
brief_fix: Evaluate fact-linked update coverage on labeled examples; do not interpret cue/term coverage as answerability.

title: Tiny-corpus BM25 negative IDF can reverse term-frequency preference
brief_fix: Compare alternative IDF treatment or BM25 variants on frozen labels; retain exact-match baseline and measure ranking quality.

title: Investigation budget adjustment leaves stale excerpt trace metadata
brief_fix: Recompute sent excerpt IDs/offsets/counts after pruning; distinguish excerpt count from grouped source count.

title: Decision-only snapshot mixes old evidence and new corpus revision
brief_fix: Preserve the saved snapshot revision for decision-only work, or explicitly mark/reject changed-source provenance; do not silently relabel old evidence.

title: Service recovery depends on caller replay of failed prompt/date
brief_fix: Make retry intent explicit or reconstruct failed operation inputs from the journal; the current UI already replays them.

title: Expansion budget can be consumed entirely by original candidates
brief_fix: Experiment with a bounded quota for genuinely new expansion candidates while measuring the loss of corroborated high-rank precision.

title: Search timing includes query embedding timing
brief_fix: Label timings inclusive/exclusive or subtract nested work; prevent misleading summation without claiming any observed latency improvement.

title: One retrieved chunk triggers unit work over its entire session
brief_fix: Pre-index source spans/units and load only relevant ranges plus explicit context; benchmark real long-session latency and cache effects.

title: One retrieval mixes old ranked chunks with newly edited source text
brief_fix: Bind candidate metadata, immutable content hashes and packing to one source snapshot; abort/retry explicitly if consistency cannot be established.

title: Completed results lack immutable source-revision reuse/export guard
brief_fix: Bind run/export to source snapshots and explicitly reject or label stale historical reuse; never auto-resend paid requests.

title: Evaluation cache ignores material question/gold/source/build changes
brief_fix: Use dataset/question/annotation/source/build/model provenance in report and frozen-selection identity.

title: Citation labels can satisfy numeric answer gold
brief_fix: Use canonical citation stripping before local answer matching and export, while preserving original responses for audit.

title: Benchmark citation correction omits original evidence constraints
brief_fix: Append repair instructions to the immutable constrained base question and reserve its full serialized budget.

title: Store and transport disagree on inconsistent weekday dates
brief_fix: Share a canonical date validator and reject invalid weekday/date pairs before persistence or remote changes.

title: Installed package API is stale and crashes Build decision view
brief_fix: Reinstall the intended release and restart via documented workflow; add normal-import installed-artifact UI smoke validation.

title: Saved entry recovery state disappears with the browser session
brief_fix: Persist entry/index/refresh job state and expose idempotent recovery after reconnect; identical same-date/content entry IDs already deduplicate.

title: Citation-only answer becomes empty after export despite completed status
brief_fix: Validate canonical answer content after citation stripping both before completion and during export.

title: Comparisons confound cache state and convenience sampling
brief_fix: Counterbalance matched runs; stratify history-disjoint samples and separately report cold/warm latency with cache state.

title: Retrieval selection objective omits span/state and answer sufficiency
brief_fix: Preserve official session metrics and add frozen auxiliary span/state labels plus held-out end-to-end evaluation before claiming an overall winner.

title: Submission readiness is a count heuristic rather than exact release identity
brief_fix: Validate a trusted dataset-release manifest and compatible completed preparation/frozen-selection stages, not just 146 IDs.

title: Partial metrics and retry timing need explicit denominators and wall clock
brief_fix: Report completed-conditional and whole-manifest metrics separately, with failure breakdowns and monotonic end-to-end elapsed time.

title: Transport envelope and benchmark snapshot need stronger boundaries
brief_fix: Subitem a: parent timeout/typed response with uncertain outcome and no blind retry. Subitem b: select compatible immutable benchmark snapshots by identity.
